newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus airline catering staff strike over TV ban.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus airline catering staff strike over TV ban.

text.p: Cyprus Airways catering staff went on strike after management banned them from watching television during working hours, their union said.

A small group of caterers at Larnaca airport stopped working for one hour on Wednesday afternoon, delaying an outbound Gulf Air flight for 45 minutes, after when they saw their television had been removed from their recreation room.

"There are several labour disputes in the catering department and when some workers saw that their television set had been moved by the management they just boiled over," union representative Andreas Pierides told Reuters on Thursday.
"They said it would only be used when there is no work, but when is there no work?" a company source said. "And what would happen if TV is showing football or basketball matches?"
